speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (MSA)

The symptoms of progressive gait difficulty, urinary incontinence, slurred speech, rigidity, tremor, and orthostatic hypotension are classic for MSA, not cellulitis. To confirm the diagnosis and rule out Parkinson's disease, please request an MRI of the brain and abdomen, and we will perform a tilt table test to evaluate your autonomic function.
